description: Search Google Patents by keywords, assignee, inventor, country, status, and date, or read patents by publication number. Returns one row per patent with title, dates, inventors, assignee, and links; with include_details also abstract, claims, CPC codes, legal status, citation counts, and legal events.

after_date.description: Optional. Only patents dated on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD. The date is the one chosen in Date field.

assignee.description: Optional. Company or owner name, for example Waymo. Applies to every search. With no search terms, it is a search on its own.

before_date.description: Optional. Only patents dated on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

country.description: Optional. Patent office codes, comma separated, for example US,EP,WO.

date_field.description: Which date After and Before use: priority (default), filing, or publication.

dedupe.description: true (default) returns each patent once per run, across all searches. Repeats are not charged.

include_details.description: true reads each patent's page too: abstract, claims count and first claim, CPC codes, legal status, expiration, citation counts, and legal events. Charged as a detail row instead of a search row. Default false.

inventor.description: Optional. Inventor name. Applies to every search. With no search terms, it is a search on its own.

language.description: Optional. Document language as Google Patents names it, for example ENGLISH or GERMAN.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_results_per_query.description: Most patents returned per search. Default 20, at most 1000 (Google Patents serves 10 pages of 100).

patent_numbers.description: Optional. Publication numbers with the kind code, for example US10000000B2 or EP3000000A1, or patents.google.com/patent links. Each is read from its patent page and returned with full details.

patent_type.description: Optional. patent (utility) or design. Empty means both.

queries.description: One search per line, as you would type it on patents.google.com, for example solid state battery. A full patents.google.com search link also works and keeps its filters. Clay users: wrap a column in a one item list.

sort.description: Empty for relevance, newest, or oldest.

status.description: Optional. grant for granted patents only, application for applications only. Empty means both.

name: search_google_patents
title: Search Google Patents
